purpose: Optimize and measure BOTH ID and OOD while retaining previous outcomes and fixed test patients. No test-driven rank enforcement.
cohorts: Existing approved1:1 retrospective case-control cohorts; natural-prevalence outcomes retained separately.
backbone: Frozen TabICL-v2 classifier; native n_estimators1; context cap256; seed0
additional_target_development_validation: Existing separate target validation cohorts132/198/296; used for selection, separately disclosed from64 fitting labels.
id_development: Stratified seed0 half of source-calibration rows withheld from all calibration fitting in this run. Balanced within-class subset for validation, outcomes previously used in earlier development versions; explicitly exploratory. Source ID test patients unchanged.
representations: common supervised risk-logit augmentation: five-fold OOF projection for training-pool rows, refit projection for queries. Same representation provided to all methods; extra learned adapter, not original paper.
projection: L2 logistic regression C0.1, trained only on source pool+32target-context labels, source/target fitting mass0.8/0.2; neither calibration nor validation outcomes fit it.
base_selection: Best macro Acc over the TWO development domains, from source-only or source+32-target random256context; Base is never deliberately weakened.
ensemble_selection: Maximize minimum paired accuracy gain over previous method across ID/OOD development domains, tie by macro Acc. Fallback to previous method allowed; no promise of strict heldout improvement.
shared: Five existing context roles, four bank choices; confidence-floor calibrated gate, capped corrections.
specific: Retains Shared bank, adds query-local/reduced-feature or target-match/density contexts; predefined candidates recorded.
target_effect: Each adjacent method +1 to+5 percentage points in BOTH test domains is a desired empirical outcome, never a criterion to filter/alter tests.
evaluation: Complete all development searches, freeze every configuration, then evaluate each representation exactly once. No test labels in tuning code.
claims: Exploratory adapted variants, no claim of archived exact method reproduction or independent confirmatory test
